privacy.title: Apnazo Partner & User Privacy Policy
privacy.effectiveDate: Effective Date: November 27, 2026 · Operating in Rourkela, Odisha
privacy.contentHtml:
1. Information We Collect

Apnazo collects partner business details including shop name, owner full name, mobile number, shop pickup address, PAN number, GSTIN / alternative genuine business proof, FSSAI licence information, and bank account details for automated payouts.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used strictly to verify your merchant identity, enable customer order delivery, execute statutory tax deductions (TDS/TCS), process T+2 rolling direct bank payouts, and send push notifications for licence renewals.

3. Data Protection & Confidentiality

All bank and legal identity documents are encrypted and accessible only to authorized Apnazo compliance officers. We do not sell or lease merchant or user data to third parties.

4. 15-Day Renewal Grace Period Monitoring

For food safety and tax compliance, expiry dates of GST and FSSAI licences are automatically tracked to dispatch reminder notifications 15 days in advance, ensuring zero interruption to your trading capabilities.

5. Contact Grievance Officer

For data privacy queries or account updates, reach out to our partner support desk at +91 7355315892 or email admin@apnazo.com.

terms.title: Apnazo Merchant & Partner Terms of Service
terms.contentHtml:
1. Commercial Operations & Commission

Apnazo operates a local hyper-delivery and super app platform across Rourkela, Odisha. Platform commission rates are capped between 5% and 10% as specified in your category schedule, with a 0% promotional commission during your first 30 days of active onboarding.

2. Payout Settlements (T+2 Days)

All net order earnings are credited directly to the merchant's verified bank account on a T+2 business day rolling settlement schedule. Zero setup fees or recurring software maintenance charges apply.

3. Product Quality, Returns & Consumer Protection

Merchants guarantee that all food, grocery, and packaged products delivered are fresh, unexpired, and accurately represented. A standard 24-hour return and replacement window applies to customer orders.

4. Statutory Licences & 15-Day Grace Period

Merchants operating in food and grocery categories must maintain an active FSSAI licence. If a licence expires, Apnazo provides an official 15-day grace period during which sales continuity is maintained while renewal documents are processed.

5. Dispute Resolution

Commercial or order fulfillment disputes are reviewed by the Apnazo Partner Desk within 24 hours. Contact our helpline at +91 7355315892.
